item.title: Alabama's unemployment rate drops to 2.7%
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) - Alabama's unemployment rate has dropped to 2.7% for the month of November, which is down from November 2024's rate of 3.3%, according to the Alabama Department of Workforce. The department said that the new rate represents 65,078 unemployed people in the state, which is compared to 78,802 in November of 2024. [...]
